preconditions.description: The number of commands N must be between 1 and 1000.
Each command must be at most 100 characters long.

preconditions.expression: all(command.startswith('Simon says ') or not command.startswith('Simon says') for command in commands)
preconditions.description: Commands must either start with 'Simon says ' or not start with 'Simon says'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(command[10:] for command in commands if command.startswith('Simon says '))
postconditions.description: The output must contain the rest of the commands that start with 'Simon says', each on a new line.
